metadata.title: AssignedToMe
metadata.home: AssignedToMe: everything assigned to you, in one list
metadata.description: Every task assigned to you in Jira, Linear, GitHub, GitLab and Azure DevOps, in one list that refreshes every hour. A macOS menu bar app, and on the web.

queue.title: My tasks
queue.count: {count, plural, one {# open task} other {# open tasks}}
queue.emptyTitle: Nothing open is assigned to you
queue.emptyDescription: Connect a board and the tasks assigned to you gather here.
queue.emptyBoardDescription: Anything assigned to you there will show up here.
queue.noResultsDescription: Try another word, or clear the filters.
queue.errorSignedOut: This sign-in has ended. Sign in to {app} again to see its tasks.
queue.noBoardsDescription: Connect Jira, Linear, GitHub, GitLab or Azure DevOps and the tasks assigned to you gather here.
queue.removeConfirm: Its saved sign-in is deleted from this browser. Nothing changes in {app}.

detail.none: Select a task to see its details.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.description: The page couldn't be shown. Trying again usually fixes it.

landing.heroTitle: Everything assigned to you, in one list
landing.heroLine: Open it in your browser, or keep it in your Mac menu bar. Every board you work on, refreshed every hour — each task opens where it lives.
landing.sourcesTitle: Connect the boards you already use
landing.keysTitle: Your tokens stay in your Mac's Keychain
landing.keysLine: No key to paste for Jira, Linear or GitHub: sign in with the account you already use.
landing.closeLine: Open the web app in any browser, or put the free Mac app in your menu bar.
landing.footerLine: Every task assigned to you, in one list.
landing.tabsLine: Named after its workspace, yours to rename.
landing.featuresTitle: Do the work from the list
landing.statementLead: One list for everything assigned to you.
landing.statementRest: Each board becomes a tab, every task opens where it lives, and the list refreshes itself every hour.
landing.heroWebNote: The web app runs in your browser, no download needed.

connect.title: Connect a board
connect.pick: Pick the tool to pull your tasks from.
connect.name: Board name
connect.nameHint: The name on the tab. Left empty, it comes from the site.
connect.orSignIn: Or sign in with your {account} account, no token needed
connect.deviceCode: Enter this code on {app}. The board is added once you have.
connect.approval: If {app} asks for an admin's approval, connect with a token above instead.
connect.keepSecret: Leave empty to keep the current one
connect.fromDevice: Already set up on your phone or Mac? Receive those boards

errors.unauthorized: Sign-in was refused. Check the details and try again.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission for this in {app}.
errors.captcha: {app} locked sign-in behind a CAPTCHA. Sign in to {app} once in your browser, then try again.
errors.blocked: Your company's network security blocked this request. For a lasting fix, ask your security team to allow {app} API access.
errors.notFound: Site not found. Check the {app} address.
errors.rateLimited: {app}'s request limit was reached. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.invalidInput: Details are missing or wrong, or the address isn't a public https site.
errors.limit: This browser holds as many boards as it can. Remove one to add another.
errors.signin: The sign-in didn't finish. Try again.

actions.noTransitions: No other status is available right now.
actions.undoUnavailable: {status} can't be set back from here. Change it in {app}.

transfer.sendStep: On your phone, open Settings → Receive from desktop; on a Mac, Settings → Receive from phone. Enter the code it shows here.
transfer.receiveStep: On your phone, open Settings → Send to desktop and enter this code. Then paste the text it copies below.
transfer.scan: Scan this with your phone. It works for 10 minutes and only with that code. On a Mac, paste the text instead.
transfer.tooManyForQr: Too many boards for one QR. Copy the text and paste it on the other device, or pick fewer boards.
transfer.closeWhenDone: When the other device says the boards were added, you can leave this page.
transfer.signInNote: {count, plural, one {# board was added with a sign-in. It goes without it, and the other device asks you to sign in once.} other {# boards were added with a sign-in. They go without it, and the other device asks you to sign in once.}}
transfer.imported: {count, plural, one {# board added} other {# boards added}}
transfer.wrongCode: This text was made for a different code. Start again on the other device with the code shown here.
transfer.expired: This transfer is older than 10 minutes. Make a new one.
transfer.noBoards: Nothing to add: these boards use tools this version doesn't know.
transfer.limit: This browser keeps at most 15 boards. Remove one, then try again.
transfer.nothingToSendHint: Add a board first, then send it to your phone or Mac.
